title: Whether a frozen cut freezes the description of the context it lies in
situation: Supersession reads: a concept, or a bounded context's description, changes only by a new version with its reason, and 'while a cut realizing it is frozen only by the architect'. The freeze concept lists examples, checks and the concepts the examples name, not a context's description. The delivered journal lets the lead supersede the description of a context that a frozen cut lies in. Raised in the meaning-roles judgment.
decision: Recommended: no. A cut realizes concepts, not a context's description, so its freeze covers the concepts its examples name and never the context's description. A new version of supersession's wording should make 'it' refer to the concept.
consequences: Accepted, the work stands as delivered, and the architect supersedes supersession's wording to remove the ambiguity. Rejected, the freeze extends to the description of each context of a frozen cut, and the freeze work gains that refusal.
